summary.para: Floating point number used to decrease or increase the relevance scores of the query. Boost values are relative to the default value of 1.0. A boost value between 0 and 1.0 decreases the relevance score. A value greater than 1.0 increases the relevance score.
The name of the dense_vector field to search against. The field can be indexed, or not indexed (index: false).

If false, the documents are scored with the full-precision vectors, regardless of the index options of the field. If true, the documents are scored with the quantized vectors of a quantized field, which is faster but less accurate. For a field that is not quantized, true has no effect.
The query vector. It must have the same number of dimensions as the field. You must provide either query_vector or query_vector_builder, but not both.
The configuration to build the query vector, for example by running a text embedding model. You must provide either query_vector or query_vector_builder, but not both.

The similarity used for scoring, which overrides the similarity of the field for this query. It defaults to the similarity of the field, or to cosine for a field that is not indexed. For bit fields, only l2_norm is supported. It can't be combined with quantized: true.
